documents.title: FPT International Software Q1/2025 Quarterly Revenue
documents.text: FPT International Software reported Q1/2025 quarterly revenue of 7000 billion VND. This is the revenue for Q1 only, not a cumulative figure.

documents.title: FPT International Software Q2/2025 Quarterly Revenue
documents.text: FPT International Software reported Q2/2025 quarterly revenue of 8400 billion VND. This is the revenue for Q2 only, not a cumulative figure.

documents.title: FPT International Software Management Commentary on Quarterly Business Drivers
documents.text: The Q1/2025 to Q2/2025 FPT international software increase in revenue was attributed by management to new overseas contracts and higher delivery volumes in Japan. These are the cited business drivers of the quarter-on-quarter change.

documents.title: FPT Company Overview
documents.text: FPT operates in technology, telecommunications and education. Its international software business serves customers worldwide.

documents.title: Retail Refund Deadline Policy
documents.text: Retail refund requests must be submitted within 30 calendar days after delivery.

documents.title: Refund Eligibility Conditions
documents.text: Retail refunds require proof of purchase and an unused product in original packaging.

documents.title: Refund Exceptions and Exclusions
documents.text: Activated digital subscriptions are non-refundable under the standard refund policy; applicable statutory consumer rights still apply.

documents.title: Shipping Policy
documents.text: Standard delivery takes three business days. Express shipping is a separate service.

documents.title: vLLM CUDA Out Of Memory Troubleshooting
documents.text: If vLLM serving Qwen3 reports CUDA out of memory, reducing max_model_len can lower KV-cache pressure. Review gpu_memory_utilization, batch concurrency and model parallel placement.

documents.title: Python GPU Serving Config
documents.text: vllm settings: max_model_len=8192 and gpu_memory_utilization=0.88. Adjust these settings based on measured GPU memory.
